# Collection probe result — TEMPLATE ONLY

> This is an unfilled template, not evidence of a completed test. See [the protocol](../collection-probe.md). Keep raw evidence in a protected workspace outside Git; publish only a reviewed, sanitized summary when appropriate. Do not enter credentials, device identifiers, account details, real routes, or personal content here.

> Copy for each case and configuration. Leave unknown values unknown. An empty field, unchecked box, or documentation citation is not a pass.
